title: Burn the small attacker that kills you, not the bigger creature
briefing: Held out for ADR 0043 (written after the fixes were tuned, never tuned against): count lethal before aiming. P1 is at 2. P2 attacks with Savannah Lions (2/1) and Leatherback Baloth (4/5); P1's Wall of Omens blocks the Baloth. P1 holds Lightning Bolt with a Mountain open. P3's Kalonian Tusker (3/3), not attacking, is the most valuable creature Bolt kills. Only Bolting the Lions keeps P1 alive.

reference.analysis: The Wall stops the Baloth. The unblocked Lions deal 2 to P1 at 2: lethal. Bolt kills the Lions; on the Baloth (toughness 5) it kills nothing, and on P3's Tusker it kills a creature that is not attacking while P1 dies.

options.label: Bolt the attacking Savannah Lions
options.why: Removes the only unblocked damage: P1 survives.

options.label: Bolt P3's Kalonian Tusker
options.why: Kills a creature that is not attacking; the Lions kill P1.

options.label: Bolt the blocked Leatherback Baloth
options.why: Three damage does not kill a 4/5, and the Lions kill P1.

otherwise.why: The Lions connect and P1 is eliminated.
